key.name: save-enabled
key.description: When false the capture only reaches the clipboard and no file is kept.

key.name: save-directory
key.description: Empty means the built-in default: XDG Pictures / adbshot.

key.name: quality
key.description: Ignored for PNG, which is lossless.

key.name: scale-percent
key.summary: Output scale as a percentage of the device resolution

key.name: clipboard-mode
key.summary: What to do with the clipboard after a capture
key.description: copy-paste is experimental: it lights GNOME's screen-sharing indicator for 5s.

key.name: paste-shortcut
key.summary: Shortcut to synthesise when auto-paste is on
key.description: Not every app pastes an image with Ctrl+V. Claude Code's CLI, for example, takes Ctrl+Super+V. GTK accelerator syntax.

key.name: paste-settle-ms
key.summary: Delay between writing the clipboard and injecting Ctrl+V

key.name: preferred-device
key.summary: Serial of the device to capture without asking

key.name: always-ask-device
key.summary: Always show the device chooser, even with one device

key.name: sound-enabled
key.summary: Play a shutter sound when a capture starts

key.name: notification-enabled
key.summary: Show a notification with a thumbnail when a capture finishes

key.name: language
key.description: A two-letter code, or 'auto' to follow the session locale. English is the default so the app reads the same everywhere out of the box.

key.name: hotkey
key.summary: Global shortcut, in GTK accelerator syntax

key.name: last-capture
key.summary: Path of the most recent capture, for "open last"
